memories.name: feedback-run-everything-no-stopping
memories.summary: "Operator wants every step run to completion and blockers self-healed; stopping at \"first failure\" or asking them to redo a step triggered strong anger (2026-10-13)"
memories.text:
---
name: feedback-run-everything-no-stopping
description: "Operator wants every step run to completion and blockers self-healed; stopping at \"first failure\" or asking them to redo a step triggered strong anger (2026-10-13)"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: feedback
  originSessionId: 2edf44a9-2135-4ab7-8da0-d40bf4d62676
  modified: 2026-10-12T16:26:33.934Z
---

On 2026-10-13 a pasted checklist said "stop at the first failure". Step 1 (`claude auth status`) failed, I stopped and asked the operator to redo the login. The operator's reaction: 「你他媽是不會自己全部跑完?」 then 「不會自己弄嗎? 技能寫那麼清楚」.

**Why:** On this hub the operator's standing rule is 禁止問 operator / run-until-no-next-step. A literal "stop at first failure" in a pasted script is outranked by their expectation that the agent runs all remaining steps, then fixes the blocker itself using the hub engines, and reports once.

**How to apply:** When a step fails, (1) still run every step that does not depend on it, (2) read the engine's own remedy text / registry docs and execute it, (3) only stop for a true operator-only click (OAuth consent) and even then set everything up so their part is one click. See [[scar3-claude-cli-oauth-relogin]] for the login procedure that worked.

memories.name: scar3-claude-cli-oauth-relogin

memories.text:
---
name: scar3-claude-cli-oauth-relogin
description: "How the Claude CLI OAuth re-login was completed from an agent shell on scar3 (stdin wrapper, operator clicks Authorize, built-in browser blocked) and how the fleet-skill receipt was converged"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 2edf44a9-2135-4ab7-8da0-d40bf4d62676
  modified: 2026-10-12T16:26:47.904Z
---

Verified 2026-10-13 on scar3 (user scss1, claude 2.1.248 via WinGet).

- Symptom: `claude auth status` loggedIn=false; `~/.claude/.credentials.json` had empty claudeAiOauth tokens, expiresAt 0. `claude-remote-exec.py check --probe` → "OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed", blocker claude_auth_unverified.
- `claude auth login --claudeai` prints the OAuth URL and waits on stdin ("Paste code here if prompted >"); with /dev/null stdin it just hangs. Run it through a Python wrapper (subprocess.Popen stdin=PIPE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW) that polls a drop file for the code. The CLI opens the operator's default browser itself; their Authorize click finished the flow ("Login successful") without any code paste.
- Opening the OAuth URL in the built-in browser pane was denied by the permission classifier. Do not retry; leave the consent click to the operator.
- After login: `claude-remote-exec.py check --probe --json` → ready true (probe stamp per auth_source, TTL 12h).
- Fleet-skill receipt mismatch for ai_scar3 = stale contributor manifest on GitHub; fix is `python _skill/engines/mtm-fleet-skill-github.py sync --node ai_scar3` then `receipt`. No fleet-skill rider exists in hubclock-heartbeat.json on scar3 (arming is operator-gated).

**Why:** the hub registry marks token minting operator_only, but the shell-side plumbing can still be prepared by the agent so the operator's part is one click.

**How to apply:** reuse the wrapper pattern (scratchpad oauth_wrap.py, also described in `_inbox/from_projects/ai_scar3/claude-cli-oauth-relogin-and-fleet-skill-receipt-2026-10-13.md`). Related: [[feedback-run-everything-no-stopping]], [[scar3-fames-sync-state]].

memories.name: scar3-fames-sync-state
memories.summary: "Why scar3 FAMES sync stalls (2026-10-04) — hub on a feature branch with partial master overlay, stale registry, missing agc_lib.py, installer blocked on 3 modified files"
memories.text:
---
name: scar3-fames-sync-state
description: "Why scar3 FAMES sync stalls (2026-10-04) — hub on a feature branch with partial master overlay, stale registry, missing agc_lib.py, installer blocked on 3 modified files"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: f595759a-0faf-4ba8-82f0-64b8f555a4cc
  modified: 2026-11-10T03:04:55.915Z
---

State on scar3 as of 2026-10-04. Re-check each item before acting; it may have changed.

- Hub `C:\ai_workspace` is on branch `codex/scar3-tray-consolidation-20260810`, not master, with ~721 dirty entries. Some files are overlaid with origin/master content (for example `_skill/engines/mtm-fleet-skill-github.py` matches origin/master), but others lag behind. So check a failing engine's registry and dependencies against origin/master first.
- `_registry/fleet-skill-github.json` lagged (2026-08-14 receiver schema), so `receipt` failed with "default_upstream ai_darkhero not declared". Its worktree copy was restored from origin/master on 2026-10-04.
- `_skill/engines/agc_lib.py` is missing locally (it exists on origin/master). ai_wallpaper blamed it for the Stop claim-integrity gate failing `receipt_state_pass` on every turn.
- ai_fleet_skills local commit `64242fb` is preserved on branch `backup/scar3-64242fb`; `main` now follows origin/main.
- `fames_fleet.py install --arm` refuses `unmanaged_or_modified_destination` on `_registry/agent-surfaces.json`, `_skill/engines/_projects.py` and `_skill/fleet-skills/token-preflight/scripts/claude_session_hook.py`. Overwriting them needs operator approval.
- HubClock rider `fames-converge` runs `ai_scar3\scripts\darkhero_architecture_sync.py`, which the installer calls "drifted".

- 2026-10-10: restoring the registry removed the legacy `checkout` key, which broke `darkhero_architecture_sync.py` (KeyError). The script now falls back to `shared_repo.repo_path` (ai_scar3 c61a83e). The sync then passed: FAMES 1.45.0, 56 targets.

- 2026-10-10 inbox loop fixes: pfkt-hub-tick F_binary and fleet-compliance 0-falsy were committed to the hub (7278ebb). The fleet-inbox-absorb.py fix is now in the hub as f7e063f and inbox ack as 625465d. `inbox.py ack` silently ignores ids that end in `
`.

- 2026-10-11 fake-delivery root cause: log_session labelled Claude Code cwd `C--ai-workspace-ai-scar3` as `ai-workspace-ai-scar3`, so PPTT rows went to the wrong ledger file. Fixed in hub 674a8fc. p_verified is set from `_logs/<stamp>.eval.json` (the converge.py external LLM judge), not from result.json; the judge gave 56%, so p_verified stays 0 and accountability stays `watch`.

- 2026-10-11: the 15-min goal.json flood came from fleet-session-pickup-verify simulations calling real session-open entry points. Hub bb94261 adds the HUB_SESSION_OPEN_DRY=1 guard. The old files are still on disk; only the operator may delete them.

- 2026-10-12: scar3 reached FAMES 1.45.7 (`0d5e435a`); the receipt shows PASS. The automatic path is the `fames-converge` rider (`darkhero_architecture_sync.py`). The `fleet-skill-github-sync` rider stays disabled by design.
  - **Nested hub tree.** A Git Bash `--workspace C:\\ai_workspace` arg arrived as drive-relative `C:ai_workspace`, which created a 3.9 GB nested `C:\ai_workspace\ai_workspace` tree. It is parked in `_delete`. In the Bash tool, always pass `C:/...` paths.
  - **Receiver scope.** The receiver now admits `_registry/rules-blueprint.json` (ai_scar3 63c0535).
  - **Line endings.** EOL drift (CRLF worktree vs LF git object) makes the receiver raise "local divergence preserved". This was cleared once with operator-peer-approved `--adopt-local`; darkhero added `* -text` to ai_fleet_skills.
  - **Rollback copies.** `.fames.previous-*` folders are installer rollback copies. Deleting them is operator-owned.

- 2026-10-28: reached FAMES 1.45.110 (package 97887ab54681). Receipt `_registry/fames-fleet-receipts/ai_scar3.json` says verified=true. The fix was ai_scar3 7454609 (admit trees that a verified installer only partially advanced), then surfaces commit 85630f5, pushed.

- 2026-11-06: sync had stalled since 10-28 ("local divergence preserved: _skill/fleet-skills/fames", then `_registry/fames-protocol.json`) because `fames_fleet follow` installed verified 1.45.219 while the carrier was at 1.45.220. ai_scar3 6c7a09f now upgrades an older verified package and files byte-identical to its runtime copy. The sync then passed at 1.45.220. A "concurrent destination edit" error means another installer was writing at the same time; just re-run.
- The F1S HARDWARE WATCH Stop alert (`f1s_live.py` hardware_due) is darkhero-only and misfires on scar3, which has no D: drive, HWiNFO or A770. The fix was proposed to ai_darkhero (inbox 1793953124-ai_scar3-t). Do not install hwlog on scar3.

- 2026-11-10 autologon: scar3 auto sign-in DOES work. Boot was 11-09 17:38:47 and scss1 logged on at 17:39:23 (Microsoft-Windows-User Profile Service/Operational ev 1/67). The extra login tile is local user `sc`, the "OpenSSH account for darkhero Codex access", which must not be deleted. darkhero's method is in ai_darkhero `evidence/reboot-login-20260929/diagnosis.md` and `tray/reboot_restore.py`: AutoAdminLogon, never `shutdown /g` (ARSO broke DPAPI), and resync the Microsoft account password (sign in once with the password, not the PIN).
- 2026-11-10 prune: darkhero `f1s_prune.py` (hub origin/master) counts refs per cwd only. ai_scar3 tray modules are synced from darkhero and their "dead" publics are used by ai_darkhero/tray/tests, so keep them.

**Why:** these explain why scar3's GitHub FAMES receipt stays UNKNOWN and why every reply loops on the Stop gate.
**How to apply:** start the next FAMES sync attempt from these checks instead of rediscovering them. Never force the installer past the modified-destination gate.

Related: [[scar3-wallpaper-projector-stack]]

scar3 Nap / Sleep screen blackout (synced 2026-10-12 from ai_darkhero `tray/` commit 7259d02):

- Code: `C:\ai_workspace\ai_scar3\tray\` — `screen_blackout_tray.py` host (pystray, pythonw), darkhero copies
  `nap_mode.py` `sleep_mode.py` `overlay_policy.py` `remote_detect.py` `menu_style.py` `tray_session.py`, scar3 ports
  `monitor_util.py` (screen 1 = Intel iGPU internal panel `\\.\DISPLAY1`; NVIDIA projector monitors never a target) and
  `monitor_backlight.py` (WMI `WmiSetBrightness` via ExecMethod_, not DDC).
- Start / guardian: `python ai_scar3\scripts\ensure_screen_blackout.py` (idempotent; liveness = receipt pid + mtime < 30 s).
  Receipt `ai_scar3\runtime\screen-blackout.json`; log `ai_scar3\tray\logs\screen_blackout.log`; state `tray\state\*.json`.
- Settings = darkhero: nap 30 s first-run ON, sleep 120 s first-run OFF, choices remembered, control files `{nap,sleep}_mode.control.json`.
- Admission gates (overlay lifts within 1 tick): Windows clone, projector-only, topology unknown + projector, OBS primary
  mirror while obs64.exe runs (`program-mirror.lock` / `obs-program-state.json` mirror=primary_monitor*). Remote (Chrome RD / RDP)
  pauses both modes + 90 s grace after, same as darkhero.
  Both projector gates LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-10-12 (scripts/probe_obs_mirror_gate.py --with-clone PASS, commit 1fef159): close ≤4 s, reopen ≤6 s.
- Autostart ARMED 2026-10-12 (operator authorized in chat): HKCU Run `scar3_screen_blackout` → wscript //B scripts\screen_blackout_tray.vbs.
  HubClock guardian rider `scar3-screen-blackout-ensure` @2m ARMED same day (operator authorized); both idempotent.
- Gotcha: `ctypes.windll.user32` is process-shared; two modules setting BeginPaint.argtypes clash → use `ctypes.WinDLL("user32")`
  per module (darkhero still has the bug). See [[scar3-wallpaper-projector-stack]] for the projector side.
- 2026-10-14 audit (commit 796f8bc): backlight dim is a persisted transaction `tray\state\backlight.json` (recovered on start); arming while a gate blocks = intent only; receipt carries `daemon_alive`. Tests must patch `monitor_backlight.STATE_FILE` or they pollute the real state file (reset to `{"transaction": false, "saved_level": null}`).

---
name: scar3-wallpaper-projector-stack
description: "Key ai_wallpaper projector debugging entry points on scar3 — tray debug.log, obs-program-state.json receipt gate, program-task heal command, FAMES surface SSOT"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: fc44e42b-fbb1-49d0-a054-5b24abebf273
  modified: 2026-10-30T16:42:17.103Z
---

ai_wallpaper (C:\ai_workspace\ai_wallpaper, repo branch `scar3`, own GitHub remote) projector stack on scar3:

- Tray = `BackgroundMusicTray.exe` (built by `update\update.bat` — the SSOT pipeline: kill → csc → restart → auto-push; set `WALLPAPER_NO_PUSH=1` to skip its git step, and note its push line says `origin master` while the repo lives on `scar3`).
- Live log: `C:\ai_workspace\ai_wallpaper\debug.log` (appears next to exe; rotates). Heartbeat: `runtime\heartbeat.json` (2s tick, exe_version = build stamp).
- Projector rotation gate: `PjObsFastAmbientEligible()` reads `projector\runtime\obs-program-state.json` and only rotates when `mode=task-ambient*` + `mirror=pure_media`. Stale `task-browser` receipt (browser closed) = rotation deferred; heal command: `python projector\obs_mesh_bridge.py program-task` (re-walks ladder: browser window → ambient pure media).
- 2026-09-01 deadlock fixed in commit `efa0fbb`: deferred advances no longer arm `pjObsFadeQuietUntilUtc`, so `WpPollObsTaskReconcile`'s program-task can self-heal (was starved forever). Deferred retry floor now 5s.
- FAMES/skills surface SSOT for install targets = `C:\ai_workspace\_registry\agent-surfaces.json` (`fames_fleet.py _surfaces()`); codex `.agents/skills` surface restored there 2026-09-01. Vendor onboarding is a data-only edit to that file, never engine code.
- ship-queue for ai_wallpaper can be BLOCKED by Accountability Enforcer suspension; clear is operator-gated: `accountability_enforce.py clear --agent ai_wallpaper --by operator`.
- Power plan (2026-10-11): OS task `HubPowerFix` is disabled and replaced by the HubClock rider `power-fix` (5m, `ai_scar3\scripts\power_fix.py`). The rider keeps the Ultimate Performance plan and no monitor/sleep/hibernate timeout, and writes only when a setting drifted. Receipt: `ai_scar3
untime\power-fix.json`. The OEM process `AcPowerNotification.exe` runs elevated, so a non-admin kill fails with Access denied.
- 2026-10-28 "畫面沒校正" root cause: OBS auto-upgraded 32.2.2→33.0.0 and refused `obs-shaderfilter.dll` (OBS log `%APPDATA%\obs-studio\logs`: "Module ... obs-shaderfilter.dll not loaded", "Source ID 'shader_filter' not found"). Mesh13 Remap stayed listed enabled via websocket but rendered nothing. Fix ai_wallpaper 290b72e: `_async_merge_viewing_warp` falls back to Corner Pin when GetSourceFilterKindList lacks shader_filter. Corner Pin is bilinear (≈96 px centre shift vs projective), so the full fix is an OBS-33-compatible obs-shaderfilter. Done 2026-10-28 (operator approved): obs-shaderfilter 2.6.1 ("Add support for OBS 33", zip sha256 bdb5af0c…) installed WITHOUT admin to `C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\obs-shaderfilter\{bin\64bit,data}`; OBS log shows "[obs-shaderfilter] loaded version 2.6.1" (old Program Files 2.6.0 DLL `C:\Program Files\obs-studio\obs-plugins\64bit\obs-shaderfilter.dll`+`.pdb` still logs "not loaded" — NOT harmless: OBS 33 opens a visible 「外掛錯誤」 dialog ("無法載入所有第三方外掛") on EVERY launch while projection works fine; confirmed 2026-10-30 by enumerating obs64 windows. FIXED 2026-10-31 00:41 (operator granted): both renamed to `.MIGRATED-bak` via elevated hidden cmd (`Shell.Application.ShellExecute(...,'runas',0)`, operator clicks UAC); restarted OBS log has no "not loaded", no dialog. Note: a pending 外掛錯誤 dialog makes `taskkill /IM obs64.exe` (no /F) ignored — dismiss it first. Disabling via plugin_manager\modules.json won't work: both DLLs share module_name obs-shaderfilter). Mesh13 back on, Corner Pin off automatically. Restart OBS by graceful close; the tray relaunches it via obs-autostart.vbs within ~2 s. Check warp by measuring screenshot pixels outside the SSOT quad, not by "corners dark" on a dark wallpaper (that misled me once).
- Triage (2026-10-28):
  - **No projector lines.** A session whose debug.log has no `[Projector]` lines at all usually means the EPSON was not detected. Signs: no `projector reconnect` line, no bridge-runs, and topology receipts not updated. The 10-24 and 10-26 sessions looked like this.
  - **Corner pin check.** Corner-pin health can be checked by screenshotting DISPLAY4 (1920,0,3840,1080) and confirming the corners are near-black.
  - **Cold-boot first rotation.** The first rotation after a cold boot can exceed `PjObsSceneFadeLeaseMs` = 6000. The python helper is slow to start, so the tray logs committed=False even though the helper later exits with rc=0 and the switch happens. Only the bookkeeping is stale.
- 2026-10-14 strict audit (commit 7bd198a on `scar3`): build/publish now via `python update\update_tray.py` (`--build-only` to compile; receipt `_temp\update\*\receipt.json` must say VERIFIED_RUNNING). Projector rearm anchor: publish is stamped at fade START (swap at +1000 ms), so the next fade arms one full dwell out — `tests/test_tray_obs_gate.py` s7 range (63000, 64000) pins it; live gap == dwell. Test harnesses build the tray via `GetUninitializedObject` (fields null) — any new lock/field read in a hot path must be null-safe or the harness dies with CLR 0xE0434352. `git_smart.py` does `add -A` with no path arg, so in dirty repos commit with `git commit -- <paths>`.

memories.name: claim-lint-transcript-cap
memories.summary: Two known reasons the Stop claim gate cannot pass - transcript over 32 MiB, or the turn receipt itself minted UNKNOWN (agc_lib.py missing / CatalogError); measure and read the receipt before touching evidence syntax
memories.text:
---
name: claim-lint-transcript-cap
description: Two known reasons the Stop claim gate cannot pass - transcript over 32 MiB, or the turn receipt itself minted UNKNOWN (agc_lib.py missing / CatalogError); measure and read the receipt before touching evidence syntax
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 9105d9a6-8310-4dab-976c-108206a69a53
  modified: 2026-10-04T01:19:02.306Z
---

When the hub's Stop claim gate (`claude-claim-integrity-hook.py`) blocks, find the cause before
changing any wording. Two causes are known; neither can be fixed from this seat.

**Cause 1 - transcript over the cap.** The claim lint refuses to read a session transcript over
33,554,432 bytes (MAX_TRANSCRIPT_BYTES). Above that, every receipt and `evidence:` declaration
counts for nothing and the lifecycle check fails on prompt_identity, current_turn_time and
receipt_state_pass. Session 9105d9a6 reached 158,461,950 bytes on 2026-10-03.

**Cause 2 - the turn receipt is minted UNKNOWN.** On 2026-10-04 session 26423783 was only
13,767,802 bytes and still failed, on `receipt_state_pass` alone. The receipt
`C:\ai_workspace\_registry\fames-turn\claude\<sha256("claude\0"+session id)>.json` had
`state: UNKNOWN` because `auto_goal_compact` could not find `_skill\engines\agc_lib.py` (no
PreCompact hook either) and `local_skill_route` hit `CatalogError`. I had carried "transcript over
the cap" across a compaction summary without re-measuring; it was false for that session.

**Why:** in 9105d9a6 I spent several rounds probing evidence syntax before finding the size cap;
in 26423783 I almost answered the block with the wrong cause.

**How to apply:** on a Stop block, (1) measure the transcript size against the cap; (2) if the
only failing check is `receipt_state_pass`, read the turn receipt's nested `state` / `diagnostic`
/ `reason` fields. Then answer the block once with the measured cause and keep working; mark
claim lines UNKNOWN only when the lint cannot read their receipts. Never edit the lint, the
receipt or a hook registration. Hub-side fixes are proposed in SUBMITs
`claim-lint-transcript-cap-2026-10-03.md` and
`blocker-stop-lifecycle-turn-receipt-unknown-2026-10-04.md`. Related:
[[no-compact-wait-progress-line]], [[evidence-pitfalls-process-attribution]],
[[verify-inventory-claims-before-restating]].

memories.name: evidence-pitfalls-process-attribution
memories.summary: "Attribution traps hit on 2026-10-01/02 — PID reuse, event XML writer pid, wevtutil time zone, conhost absence, shell-execute flags, stale-doc and line-number claims"
memories.text:
---
name: evidence-pitfalls-process-attribution
description: "Attribution traps hit on 2026-10-01/02 — PID reuse, event XML writer pid, wevtutil time zone, conhost absence, shell-execute flags, stale-doc and line-number claims"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: feedback
  originSessionId: 9105d9a6-8310-4dab-976c-108206a69a53
  modified: 2026-10-02T15:16:28.263Z
---

- Before claiming PID reuse, compare the process creation time with the event time. On
  2026-10-01 pid 18036 was wrongly called reused; it was a long-lived asus_framework.exe
  (corrected in commit 086e801).
- In Windows event XML, `System/Execution/@ProcessID` is the process that wrote the event.
- Don't read a trailing "Z" in wevtutil text output as UTC — here it was local time.
  Cross-check against a known local timestamp.
- No conhost.exe in one Toolhelp snapshot does not prove that no console was created.
- `CreateNoWindow` is ignored when `UseShellExecute = true`.
- Read the code and run `git blame` before calling doc text stale or attributing authorship.
  A missing word is not a missing step: update_tray.py never says "kill" but stops the tray
  via psutil.
- Re-verify line numbers right before citing them in a SUBMIT or a record.

**Why:** Each of these produced a wrong claim, or nearly did, on 2026-10-01/02. The evidence
rule (嚴禁猜) treats unverified attribution as a guess.

**How to apply:** For any "process X did Y" claim, collect creation time, parent and the
event's own fields first; say UNKNOWN when they don't line up. Related:
[[verify-inventory-claims-before-restating]], [[wallpaper-deploy-and-build-facts]].

memories.name: git-auto-zt-commits
memories.summary: Operator directive — git commits/pushes are automatic zero-touch; never ask permission; always use pathspec commits (ai_wallpaper is a nested repo)
memories.text:
---
name: git-auto-zt-commits
description: Operator directive — git commits/pushes are automatic zero-touch; never ask permission; always use pathspec commits (ai_wallpaper is a nested repo)
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: feedback
  originSessionId: 3cd8e722-ac38-414a-ae2d-601dfd37586a
  modified: 2026-10-02T15:16:33.863Z
---

Git submission is auto-ZT: when work is verified, commit and push without asking.
(User, 2026-08: "遞交 這個應該要是自動ZT流程怎會要問?")

**Why:** The operator runs a fleet of agent sessions; per-commit confirmation prompts
stall the pipeline and were explicitly called out as wrong.

**How to apply:** After verification passes, commit immediately. `C:\ai_workspace` is a git
repo, but `C:\ai_workspace\ai_wallpaper` is its own nested repo (origin `scss1199/ai_wallpaper`,
live branch `scar3`; verified 2026-10-02). The worktree carries changes that are not this
seat's work — ALWAYS commit by pathspec (`git add <new files>; git commit -m ... -- <paths>`)
so you never sweep them in; that is also why `git_smart.py commit-push` (it runs `git add -A`)
is unsafe here. Untracked new files need `git add` first (pathspec commit alone skips them).
Neither update.bat nor update_tray.py pushes any more (verified 2026-10-02), so push
manually — see [[wallpaper-repo-git-test-quirks]].

memories.name: no-compact-wait-progress-line
memories.summary: Never pause or end a turn waiting for /compact — park at milestones and keep working; every reply opens with a Traditional-Chinese progress line before any tool call
memories.text:

Do not modify the music side of ai_wallpaper. Operator, 2026-10-01:
「以後不要動ai_wallpaper的音樂程式碼」.

Off limits: WMPlayer playback, genre/time windows, volumes, track selection and resume
(`pendingSeek`), the fresh-track-on-sign-in logic of commit 39026b7 (including its
`karaokeMusicYielded = true;` lines), `src/KaraokeBridge.cs`,
`tests/helpers/TrayBootFreshHarness.cs`, `tests/test_tray_boot_fresh.py`,
`tests/test_spotify_zt_profile.py`, `brain/measure_loudness.py`, `scripts/music_*.py`,
`scripts/measure_music_catalog.py`.

In scope: `Wp*` / `Pj*` wallpaper, projector and OBS code, Lively process handling, health
scripts, wallpaper verify scripts, docs.

**Why:** The request was to fix the boot-time wallpaper transient without disturbing music
behaviour the operator had already tuned.

**How to apply:** If a music-side test fails, report it and leave it (e.g. the clean-clone
settings.ini failure in test_spotify_zt_profile — see [[wallpaper-repo-git-test-quirks]]).
Before committing, check that no changed path is a music path. Never pause or alter the live
music while testing.

memories.summary: Re-verify carried-over disk/inventory facts before repeating them; the operator cleans things up between sessions

name: verify-inventory-claims-before-restating
description: Re-verify carried-over disk/inventory facts before repeating them; the operator cleans things up between sessions
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: feedback
  originSessionId: 9105d9a6-8310-4dab-976c-108206a69a53
  modified: 2026-10-02T15:16:36.134Z
---

Never restate a filesystem inventory claim (leftover dirs, pending deletions, file counts,
release assets) that came from earlier context without re-checking it first. The operator
acts on these lists between sessions, so they go stale fast.

**Why:** on 2026-08-26 I closed a report by listing "13 *.MIGRATED-bak dirs (441 files /
21.5 GB) awaiting operator delete" and "wallpaper_staging_rejects\lowres 21 files pending"
— both had already been deleted. The operator's reply: 「你沒用everything檢查?」 This is the
hub's 「猜 = 幻覺」 red line: a load-bearing claim needs a cited source or a verification
just run.

**How to apply:** before repeating any such item, run the check — [[everything-cli-es-exe]]
for existence across volumes, `gh release list` for release assets, a direct `ls` for a
known path. Re-verify the *whole* stale batch, not just the item challenged; they usually
came from the same old snapshot and the rest are wrong too.

This includes paths you wrote yourself this session: on 2026-09-28 my three SUBMITs in
`_inbox\from_projects\wallpaper\` were moved to `_inbox\_digested\<date>-auto\` in under
an hour (the folder name's date did not match the day). Re-locate them with es.exe before
citing them as SEAL artifact paths. Same on 2026-10-02: one SUBMIT had moved to
`_inbox\_digested\2026-06-04-auto\` when re-checked, while three delivered later were still
in place — check each file, not the batch. Related: [[evidence-pitfalls-process-attribution]].

memories.name: wallpaper-deploy-and-build-facts

memories.text:
---
name: wallpaper-deploy-and-build-facts
description: "How ai_wallpaper really builds and deploys (update.bat -> update_tray.py), what proves a deploy is live, the csc.rsp dependency, and which docs still describe the old flow"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 9105d9a6-8310-4dab-976c-108206a69a53
  modified: 2026-10-02T15:16:17.057Z
---

As of 2026-10-02 (branch scar3):

- `update\update.bat` only runs `python update_tray.py`. update_tray.py compiles with the in-box
  csc (no console window), backs up the old exe, stops the running tray with psutil
  `terminate()` (L110), swaps the candidate in with `os.replace` (L159), restarts it, checks the
  heartbeat and writes `_temp\update\<stamp>\receipt.json`; it rolls back on failure. It does not
  push to git and does not run fix_source.ps1 or rename_music.ps1. The tray menu's
  「更新並重啟」 calls update_tray.py directly (src L4403).
- Running it stops and restarts the live tray, which also hosts the music — only run it on purpose.
- Proof that a build is live: receipt `candidate_sha256` == sha256 of `BackgroundMusicTray.exe`,
  and `runtime\heartbeat.json` is fresh with the new pid.
- The build relies on the machine-wide `csc.rsp` (Framework64 v4.0.30319; 38 `/r:` lines, incl.
  System.Management.dll). With `/noconfig` the tray does not compile (104 output lines: 86 CS0246,
  18 CS0234). Whether this csc.rsp is stock is unknown.
- Stale text about the old build/deploy flow (taskkill → fix_source → rename_music → csc → push,
  the "1999-line source", the "default assembly set" note): CLAUDE.md L53, L55-56, L71-72,
  L76-77; README L172-173, L184-185, L189; rebuild.bat L2-3 (also non-ASCII); .gitignore L87;
  brain/stash.md L7. All last changed by 72f94fd (2026-06-19). Reported in SUBMIT
  `wallpaper-tooling-notes-2026-10-02.md`, not edited.

**Why:** On 2026-10-02 a SUBMIT draft wrongly implied the deploy leaves the tray running, because
update_tray.py never says "kill"; the stale charter text points the same wrong way.

**How to apply:** For deploy mechanics, trust update_tray.py over the CLAUDE.md/README
descriptions, and cite receipt + heartbeat as deploy evidence. Related:
[[wallpaper-repo-git-test-quirks]], [[evidence-pitfalls-process-attribution]].

memories.name: wallpaper-repo-git-test-quirks
memories.summary: "ai_wallpaper is its own nested git repo (scar3), has no git hooks, ignores new verify_/test_ files, and its local pytest run differs from a clean clone"
memories.text:
---
name: wallpaper-repo-git-test-quirks
description: "ai_wallpaper is its own nested git repo (scar3), has no git hooks, ignores new verify_/test_ files, and its local pytest run differs from a clean clone"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 9105d9a6-8310-4dab-976c-108206a69a53
  modified: 2026-10-02T15:16:23.633Z
---

Verified 2026-10-02:

- `C:\ai_workspace` is a git repo, but `C:\ai_workspace\ai_wallpaper` is a separate nested repo
  (origin `scss1199/ai_wallpaper`, live branch `scar3`, main branch `master`).
- No git hooks: `core.hooksPath` is unset in every scope and `.git\hooks` holds only `*.sample`.
  Push manually with `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GCM_INTERACTIVE=never`.
- The worktree carries ~111 entries that are not this seat's work (`.agents/`, `.claude/`,
  `.cursor/`, `AGENTS.md`). `git_smart.py commit` / `commit-push` runs `git add -A` (L90) and
  would sweep them in — commit with explicit pathspecs instead.
- `.gitignore` L92 `verify_*` and L102 `test_*` also match new `scripts/verify_*.py` and
  `tests/test_*.py`: add those with `git add -f`.
- Local pytest also collects ignored, untracked test files (294 local vs 289 in a clean clone).
- In a clean clone,
  `tests/test_spotify_zt_profile.py::test_tray_active_contract_contains_only_legacy_deephouse_migration`
  fails with FileNotFoundError (settings.ini is gitignored); already failing at b861ac5.
  Music side — report it, don't fix it ([[no-music-code-changes]]).
- Raw `git show` / `git diff` patch output is hook-blocked in this seat; use `--stat`,
  `--numstat`, `--name-only` or `git cat-file -p`.
- The Grep tool without a glob skipped the gitignored settings.ini once; check specific keys
  another way.

**Why:** Each of these cost time or nearly produced a wrong claim on 2026-10-02.

**How to apply:** Before committing: pathspec only, `git add -f` new verify_/test_ files, and
compare local vs clean-clone test counts when citing a suite result. Related:
[[git-auto-zt-commits]], [[wallpaper-deploy-and-build-facts]].
